strategy: Technology Leadership + AI/Cloud Transformation + Telecom/Enterprise + Strategic Customer + Strategy-to-Execution
principles: Prioritize recurring gaps with measurable 30-90 day screening value.
Do not attempt to retrofit structural history such as years in a major consulting firm.
Do not infer causality from a single rejection; require multiple comparable outcomes.
Never invent metrics; use only values or ranges defensible in interview.
Do not redirect the profile toward pure hands-on AI/ML engineering unless market outcomes justify it.

priority_gaps.gap: Quantified enterprise/commercial and transformation impact evidence
market_evidence: Telefónica Account Executive Grandes Clientes measures revenue, new sales and customer satisfaction.
Telefónica Account Specialist Data/AI expects identification, construction and closure of high-value Data/AI opportunities.
AWS Enterprise Account Manager requires identification, negotiation and closure of large-scale technology deals and a proven quota-carrying complex-cloud-sales track record.
AWS Customer Solutions Manager Madrid requires business-case development, realized customer benefits and measurable outcomes.
priority_gaps.action_today: Complete one Nokia/Telefónica evidence block with account scope, confirmed contract/revenue range, proposals/RFPs, team scale, transformation delivered and measurable result.
priority_gaps.target_evidence: 8-12 defensible quantified achievements across Nokia/Telefónica, CANTV and current AI/cloud work.
priority_gaps.selection_probability_effect: No numeric uplift assigned yet; outcome evidence remains insufficient.

market_evidence: Telefónica Data/AI significantly values Data Governance and AI Governance credentials.
AWS Customer Solutions Manager Madrid explicitly prefers AWS or another cloud certification.
Repeated active AWS Spain opportunities increase the reusable value of hyperscaler credentials.

Capgemini Invent senior transformation roles typically expect substantial consulting history.
priority_gaps.action_today: Reframe verified advisory/transformation work as consulting evidence and deprioritize roles where major-firm consulting tenure is an explicit knockout criterion.

AWS Enterprise Greenfield Account Manager requires cloud selling, revenue/adoption pipeline building and complex deal closure.
